•Revenue  grew 17.3% YoY to 984M baht, fueled by 36 new 
Moshi Moshi  branches ( 165 → 201 stores)
•Wholesale  declined 9.1% mainly due to lower Middle 
Eastern tourist traffic at Platinum Fashion Mall, 
compounded by other factors including ongoing 
construction in front of the mall that disrupted foot traffic 
and accessibility.
•Other channels grew 41.8%, with online + 44.4% and 
warehouse sales + 63.5%
•SSSG  remained positive at 3.8%, sustained by licensed 
products, seasonal merchandise, and ongoing sales 
initiatives
•Revenue  declined 15.5% QoQ to 984M baht, in line with 
normal seasonality as 4Q is traditionally the industry's peak 
consumption quarter
•Retail  declined 14.2% QoQ, consistent with post -high season 
patterns, while the Company continued expanding with 6 
new branches (including 2 Standalone)
•Wholesale  declined 29.8% QoQ, pressured by seasonal 
factors alongside ongoing tourist decline and traffic 
disruption at Platinum Fashion Mall
•Other channels grew 14.2% QoQ, driven by online and 
warehouse sales momentum.

Gross Profit Margin (GPM)
•Gross profit grew 19.4% YoY to 554M baht, with margin 
improving from 55.3% to 56.3% 
•Margin expansion driven by higher share of imported 
goods, growth in high -margin categories ( e.g. home 
furnishing), and Thai baht appreciation vs. Chinese 
yuan in the first two months and supported by retails 
network expansion to 201 branches and a favorable 
product mix shift
•Gross profit declined 16.0% QoQ to 554M baht, 
consistent with seasonal patterns following 4Q peak 
season 
•Gross Profit Margin remained  resilient at 56.3% (vs. 
56.6% in 4Q25), supported by a diverse product mix 
including licensed products, special collections, and 
seasonal merchandise for key occasionsYoY: 1Q2026 vs 1Q2025
QoQ: Q42025 vs 1Q2026

Selling Expense
•Selling expenses rose 19.0% YoY to 278M baht, driven 
by planned costs from 36 new branch openings — 
including staff, rent, utilities, and setup expenses
• Selling expense ratio edged up slightly to 28.2% (vs. 
27.7% in 1Q25), reflecting necessary investment to 
support sustainable growth
•Marketing investment continued, with successful 
brand activations featuring well -known artists driving 
strong Social Media engagement and brand 
awareness
•Selling expenses decreased 10.0% QoQ to 278M baht, 
in line with post -high season revenue decline 
•Selling Expense ratio rose to 28.2% (vs. 26.4% in 4Q25), 
reflecting the relatively fixed nature of branch 
operating costs against lower seasonal revenueYoY: 1Q2026 vs 1Q2025

•Total assets grew 5.2% to 5,316M baht, with key drivers being right -of-use 
assets (+135M), debt instrument investments (+92M), and cash (+39M), 
partially offset by lower post -season inventories ( -32M)
•Total liabilities rose 3.2% to 2,394M baht, mainly from higher lease liabilities 
(+138M) on branch expansion and higher tax payable (+34M) on growing 
profits, while trade payables fell ( -99M) as year -end advance orders were 
settled
•Shareholders' equity increased 7.0% to 2,921M baht, reflecting strong 
operating performance during the quarter
Financial structure remains solid — sound liquidity, zero borrowing 
obligations, well -positioned to support continued expansion
